input.quote: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: Paragraph 4(a) gives AP no termination-for-convenience right during the Initial Term, and the Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms, so AP is locked in with only a 90-day post-term exit. This falls short of the preferred position (Customer convenience termination on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees) and is a missing-behaviour deviation for a term that rolls beyond 12 months. The clause is also symmetrical, giving Kubient a walk-away right on 90 days' notice at any time after the Initial Term rather than only at the end of a term. The redline adds a 30-day AP convenience right with refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination penalty, and confines Kubient's convenience right to the end of the then-current Term on 90 days' notice; the 60-90 day fallback is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add AP a 30-day termination-for-convenience right with refund of prepaid fees; limit Kubient's convenience right to end of term on 90 days' notice.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees, since the agreement otherwise locks us in for an auto-renewing term with no exit, and limited Kubient's convenience right to the end of the then-current Term on ninety (90) days' notice. If you need a longer runway we can accept 60-90 days' notice for our termination.

ops.oldText: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Exhibit for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time (including during the Initial Term) upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Kubient, in which case Kubient shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination and no early termination fee or other penalty shall apply. Kubient may terminate this Agreement for convenience only effective as of the end of the then-current Term and upon not less than ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Customer.
